grades.reason: RISC-V-only passage. Its rationale says the F extension's conversion operations read and write the integer register file directly. That covers the RISC-V half of the question: FP-to-integer results go to the integer register file. It doesn't name FCVT.W.S specifically, and it says nothing about LoongArch.
